spec.kitLine: on Full Charge hit: target ATK down 8.94%
spec.assertion: Proves the debuff never leaks onto an ally (no quiry-sourced negative buff; no ally buff at the computed 8.94%-of-caster-ATK flat, derived from the co-basis 5.81% grant) and never becomes a boss-held Damage Taken debuff (boss-debuff tally identical with skill1 emptied). Fails under the nearest-wrong models: scoping the ATK down onto the 2 Defenders alongside the ATK up, or re-encoding an enemy ATK down as damageTakenPct (which would credit the whole team).

spec.kitLine: on Full Charge: 2 Defenders ATK up 5.81%
spec.assertion: Four assertions: (1) stat is casterAtkPct emitting a FLAT ATK (>100), failing under an atkPct model that emits the raw 5.81 and scales the target's own ATK; (2) >=50 applications over 180 s, failing under passive (1), burstCast (~3) or fullBurstEnter (~12) trigger identities; (3) the quiry-sourced target set is exactly {crown}, and the retargeted-to-allies counterfactual sprays >1 slug and lifts helm's total — failing under target allies / alliesTopAtk; (4) durationShots undefined and the first expiresFrame in (100,340) — ~f262 for 3 s off an ~f82 first charge — with the durationSec:10 counterfactual moving it by >350 frames, failing under a rounds-based or 5 s/10 s window. Non-vacuity: crown's total drops when skill1 is emptied.

spec.kitLine: battle start: 2 Defenders Max HP up 11.63%
spec.assertion: Proves a passive trigger identity (1..5 applications, not the ~100 of a per-shot trigger), Defender-only targeting (no maxHpFlat to liter/helm/quiry), continuity (no durationShots, expiresFrame absent or beyond the fight), and the TARGET-own-HP basis: patching the stat to casterMaxHpPct changes the emitted flat maxHpFlat, since crown (Defender) and quiry (Supporter) have different Max HP. Also pins documented inertness — totals are byte-identical with skill2 emptied (ally-granted Max HP feeds no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer in this comp), so the line is kept for completeness, not damage.

Read through crown, the fixture's on-recovery consumer, since the event log has no heal/recovery kind. ticks:10 must produce strictly more buffApply events than the ticks:1 counterfactual (a single instant heal) and than the self-only-target counterfactual. Fails under the nearest-wrong models: heal with default ticks:1 (an instant heal instead of a 10-tick HoT) and target self (which would strand the teammate consumer). The all-allies-including-self scope itself is a gap (it.skip).

Asserts stat critRatePct at exactly 19.9 with zero critRateNormalPct@19.9 events (the kit line is unscoped, so scoping it to normal attacks would under-credit skill/burst crit); target set exactly {crown} with the retarget-to-allies counterfactual lifting both helm and liter totals; and a full 10 s window via the durationSec:5 counterfactual dropping crown's total (the cast lands just before Full Burst, so half the window is half the FB crit uptime). The event count also doubles as the fixture non-vacuity check that quiry, a Burst II sharing the stage with crown, actually casts (1..5 times).

fixtures: controlComp('quiry', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / quiry (carry) / helm (B3), 10 hoisted 180 s runs (baseline + 9 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals). The fixed B3 (helm) is KEPT: quiry is Burst II, so dropping it would leave the team without a B3 and produce zero Full Bursts, killing every burst-line assertion. crown is the comp's only Defender (liter/helm are Attackers, quiry a Supporter), which gives all three Defender-scoped lines one live target plus three inert witnesses; crown is also the only on-recovery consumer, the sole observable channel for the burst HoT. Quiry-sourced buff events are isolated by tally-diffing against slot-emptied runs rather than by assuming a caster index, so the file survives any slot ordering.
gaps: it.skip — the '2 Defender ally unit(s)' CAP on skill1 and skill2 is inexpressible: TargetDef alliesOfClass has no count field (unlike alliesTopAtk / alliesLowestAtk / alliesOfElementWeapon), so a 3+-Defender team would over-apply both lines. It is also unexercised here: the control comp holds exactly one Defender.

it.skip — the skill1 ATK down on the target has no observable magnitude or window in v1: there is no enemy entity (resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns []) and the boss deals no damage at scope lock, so only its inertness is testable.

OBSERVABILITY (folded into the HoT it.skip) — 'Affects all allies' on the burst heal cannot be confirmed for liter / helm / quiry: the event log exposes no heal or recovery kind, and crown is the only unit in the fixture carrying a recovery trigger. Self-receipt in particular (allies vs allies+excludeSelf) is undiscriminable in any fixture without a self-consuming recovery trigger on quiry.

NOT A GAP, A NOTE — the ATK-up duration test leans on the measured 60f charge + 22f release-latency opening to bound the first expiresFrame; the paired durationSec:10 counterfactual is what makes it a sensitivity test rather than a magic number.
